correctness.rationale: The displayed Lyapunov function is nonnegative and proper toward all forbidden faces; its derivative is exactly -(x-x_star)(q(x)-q(x_star)). Strict monotonicity of q proves global critical convergence for every interior initial condition. The oriented reward/cooperation variables give an eventually one-sided positive slow variable. Variation of constants yields z/y→1/q_prime and 1/y~Dt/q_prime, followed by a second-order tracking error O(y^2) and an integrable remainder proving the stated inverse-reward logarithmic law. Rational test parameters and 76 checks, including trajectories for both boundaries, corroborate but do not replace proof.

value.rationale: Critical reward saturation is a natural equilibrium regime of the primary public-goods/institutional-feedback model. The exact universal cooperation decay amplitude informs finite-time adjustment near saturation, while the second-order logarithmic term separates feedback speed from leading-order behavior, explaining a structural dynamical distinction invisible to previous qualitative stability theorems.
